classifications.authority_or_basis: Agora product and terms materials identify Agora Bermuda Limited as AUSD issuer and state that it is licensed by the Bermuda Monetary Authority for digital-asset business activities in and from Bermuda.

licensed_or_regulated_as: Bermuda digital asset business — issuer-stated BMA licensed entity
notes: AUSD is recorded as a fiat-backed stablecoin issued by Agora Bermuda Limited. The reviewed public sources support verified-customer mint and redemption rights but do not establish universal direct issuer redemption for every holder, bankruptcy remoteness, or complete historical reserve segregation mechanics.
